title: Khilwat Mubarak, Chowmahalla Palace

buildingCutout.basis: The mapped hall envelope fixes the dated building independently of the wider palace site.

terrainReference.basis: Original ground on the north approach, outside the facade envelope.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap way 116030267 fixes the building envelope, identified as the main Khilwat hall inside the named Chowmahalla compound. The palace operator distinguishes this hall from the separate clock tower.
mapIdentity.scope: Native Khilwat way 116030267 fixes the hall envelope. Two exact May 2020 CC0 views and the palace description establish the yellow and white plaster, cusped arcade, rooftop pavilions and marble entrance steps.

note: The original north courtyard ground defines model zero. Two dated exterior photographs guide the raised plinth, double-height arch proportions and pavilion tiers. Absolute facade and roof heights are estimates.
